title: PAVOQUE Corpus of Expressive Speech
manual_annotation_evidence: Repository supplies manually corrected phone-level segmentation; corpus paper states phone-level segmentation is available for all recorded utterances and labels were manually checked/corrected where needed
utterances_or_phrases: 3000 neutral sentences plus expressive recordings; exact public YAML utterance count to be computed after complete file materialization
eligible_scope: Six public YAML annotation objects and corresponding original FLAC release audio; primary read/acted speech only
excluded_scope: Downstream synthetic voices/TTS outputs; CAMEO repackaging; any derived speech synthesis artifacts
notes: One male native German speaker; five intended styles neutral/happy/sad/angry/poker. Speaker is also a trained opera singer, but PAVOQUE recordings are spoken/read expressive speech, not singing. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Preserve SAMPA labels verbatim; do not infer IPA without explicit mapping.
